spans.s:
गाथ, अस्, m. (also अम्, n. ?), singing, a song;
(आ), f. a verse; (in the terminology of the Brāhmaṇas
and liturgical books) a verse which is neither Ṛc,
nor Sāman, nor Yajus, a religious verse, but not one
belonging to the Vedas; a stanza; a song, a chant or
verse to be chanted or sung; (with Buddhists) a
metrical Sūtra; N. of the Āryā metre; also of a
metre not enumerated in the regular treatises on
prosody.
—गाथ-पति, इस्, m., Ved. lord of songs.
—गाथा-कार, अस्, m. an author of songs, hymns,
verses; a singer, a reciter.
—गाथा-नी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved.
leading the song, leading a choir.
—गाथान्तर
(˚था-अन्˚), अस्, m., N. of a Kalpa, the fourth day in
Brahmā's month.

गाथक, अस्, m. a singer, a musician; a chanter
of the Purāṇas or sacred poems.

गाथिक, अस्, m. one who recites Gāthas, hymns
or verses; (आ), f. a song, hymn.

गाथिन्, ई, इनी, इ, familiar with or knowing songs
or hymns, a singer; (ई), m., N. of a son of Kuśika
and father of Viśvā-mitra; (इनस्), m. pl. the de-
scendants of this man; (इनी), f., N. of a metre,
containing 12 + 18 + 12 + 20 or 32 + 29 syllabic
instants; [cf. वीणा-गाथिन्.]
—गाथि-ज, अस्, m. the
son of Gāthin, i. e. Viśvā-mitra.
गाथिन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Gāthin.
